newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy coastguard intercepts 250 illegal immigrants.
newsitem.headline: Italy coastguard intercepts 250 illegal immigrants.

text.p: Italian coastguards intercepted a boat packed with 200 illegal immigrants on Thursday and a further 50 were picked up on land, police said.

They said the boat, registered in the Lebanese capital Beirut, was carrying mainly people from Pakistan, India and Iraq when it was caught trying to reach the Calabrian coast, at the toe of the Italian peninsula.
The immigrants included many women and children.
Some 50 other people managed to disembark but were arrested and brought back to the boat, police said.
It was not immediately clear if the crew were still on the boat. Italy normally arrests those caught helping illegal immigrants reach the country.
Italy has been swamped this year by some 14,000 Albanian immigrants, who flooded across the Adriatic after the collapse of order in the nearby Balkan state.
